card.title: Stay for the Hard Part
card.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?

mechanism: A stages deeper admissions about avoiding a reunion and asks B to remain beside them through the vulnerable explanation.
confusable: Unlike an ordinary excuse for lateness, each admission must expose more while testing support.
comparison: D107-b ends with wanting the saved seat despite fear; D107-a ends with asking support after admitting relationship doubt.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
